title: Fully Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2505.22442v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Offline RL (ORL) promises safe and sample-efficient deployment but existing methods rely on undocumented online interactions for hyperparameter tuning and lack reliable fully offline estimates of initial online performance. We introduce SOReL, a fully offline Bayesian model-based RL method that learns a posterior over dynamics, estimates policy value via predictive uncertainty, and enables complete offline hyperparameter selection. We further propose TOReL, which extends this tuning framework to arbitrary model-free and model-based ORL algorithms. We provide a regret analysis showing that Bayesian offline RL achieves the minimax-optimal parametric rate under standard regularity conditions. Together, our methods establish a practical and theoretically grounded framework for fully offline RL.

translated_abstract: 离线强化学习（ORL）有望实现安全且样本高效的部署，但现有方法依赖未记录的在线交互来进行超参数调优，且缺乏对初始在线性能的可靠的完全离线估计。我们提出了SOReL，这是一种完全离线的贝叶斯基于模型的强化学习方法，它学习动力学模型的后验分布，通过预测不确定性来估计策略价值，并支持完全离线的超参数选择。我们进一步提出了TOReL，将这一调优框架扩展到任意无模型和基于模型的ORL算法。我们提供了遗憾分析，表明贝叶斯离线强化学习在标准正则性条件下达到了极小极大最优的参数化速率。总之，我们的方法为完全离线强化学习建立了一个实用且有理论支撑的框架。
tldr: 提出了完全离线的贝叶斯模型强化学习方法SOReL及其扩展框架TOReL，实现了无需在线交互的完全离线超参数调优与性能估计，并通过遗憾分析证明其达到极小极大最优的参数化速率。
en_tdlr: We introduce SOReL, a fully offline Bayesian model-based RL method, and its extension TOReL, enabling complete offline hyperparameter tuning and performance estimation without online interactions, with regret analysis showing minimax-optimal parametric rates.
